clue.text: Pointed note written in the bar

definitions.meaning: pointed means keen-edged, able to cut or prick
in music a ... is a note raised a semitone, written with its sign within a bar of the score

explanation.surface: A barbed remark scribbled down in the pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bar' looks like a pub; it is a bar of written music.
explanation.definitionFit: A keen blade or point is described with the same word as a raised musical note.

clue.text: Steps to be taken when car-seat is replaced

indicators.note: replaced means the letters of car-seat and is are put back in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Advice to climb on foot once the car's seat has been swapped out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'replaced' turns CARSEAT plus IS into the new word.
explanation.definitionFit: A flight of stairs is a set of steps inside a building.

clue.text: The Greek's a character!

parts.note: reads as a remark about an eccentric Greek man, but means the first letter of the Greek ...

explanation.surface: Someone remarks that a Greek acquaintance is quite an eccentric.
explanation.definitionFit: The first letter of the Greek alphabet is a written character used by Greeks.

clue.text: Declare that one's not an amateur?

definitions.text: Declare that one's not an amateur?

parts.words: Declare that one's not an amateur?
parts.note: read literally; the plain sense is simply to announce

explanation.surface: A sportsman insists publicly on professional status.
explanation.definitionFit: To announce something publicly is to declare it; split in two the word is a professional's claim.

clue.text: Newsmen going into action can get despondent

indicators.note: going into says the newsmen are placed inside the word for action

parts.note: a deed is an action
the press are journalists collectively

explanation.surface: Reporters going into battle may well feel low.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling low or dejected is being down in spirits, a synonym for despondent.

clue.text: Two-party contest

parts.note: sounds like an election between two political parties, but means a fight between two people

explanation.surface: A political election with only two parties standing.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal fight between two people, as with pistols at dawn, is a contest of two parties.

clue.text: History teacher, a man of particular talent?

parts.note: history is the past
a schoolmaster is a teacher, so master

explanation.surface: Describing a history teacher as an exceptionally gifted man.
explanation.definitionFit: An expert, someone thoroughly skilled at something, is called this.

clue.text: Followed in order to bring charges in extremity

indicators.note: the second in places the word for bringing charges within the word for extremity

parts.note: the end is the extremity
to sue is to take legal action, bringing charges

explanation.surface: Something followed so that charges could be brought at the last extreme.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'in' belongs to 'in order to'; the second is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that ensued came after, as a result, so it followed.

clue.text: Thought to be sensitive about a large figure

indicators.note: about means the word for sensitive goes round the large figure

parts.note: sentient means able to feel, sensitive
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, a large figure

explanation.surface: Being touchy about a large number was considered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Thought' looks like a verb but is the noun: an opinion or feeling.
explanation.definitionFit: An opinion or view is a thought held on a matter.

clue.text: Mounted guard left to, speak at length

indicators.note: in a down clue mounted means the word for guard is written upwards

parts.note: to ward is to guard

explanation.surface: A mounted sentry was left to give a long speech.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mounted' reverses WARD to DRAW, since in a down entry it climbs upward.
explanation.definitionFit: To talk slowly with lengthened vowels is to speak with drawn-out length.

clue.text: Lovely flowers — heaps sold for arrangement

indicators.note: for arrangement says the letters of heaps and sold are to be reorganised

explanation.surface: Florist sells piles of beautiful blooms arranged in bunches.
explanation.definitionFit: These are lilies, legendary flowers of the Elysian fields.

clue.text: Boy, one accompanying a girl

parts.note: a son is a boy
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A boy, one escorting a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's given name, so a girl in crossword terms.

clue.text: Military personnel combine for special purposes, I assure you

parts.note: RE stands for the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
to ally is to join together for a particular aim

explanation.surface: Troops unite for a special mission, says the speaker earnestly.
explanation.definitionFit: An interjection of emphasis meaning truly or honestly, as an assurance.

clue.text: Hazard about a sovereign

indicators.note: about means the word for hazard wraps round the letter a

parts.note: to imperil is to hazard or endanger

explanation.surface: Danger surrounding a reigning monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hazard' is a verb here, not the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to an emperor or empire, so royal and supreme, sovereign in rank.

clue.text: Indifferent to cautions in letters

indicators.note: letters says the clue words are treated as a set of letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone takes no notice of warnings set down in writing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'letters' suggests correspondence but signals rearranging the letters of CAUTIONS IN.
explanation.definitionFit: Being carefree and unconcerned is the same as not caring, being indifferent.

clue.text: Giving ill-disposed sister a nod — such craft!

indicators.note: ill-disposed means the letters are badly arranged and need rearranging

explanation.surface: A grumpy sibling grants a nod, showing great cunning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ill-disposed' reads as unfriendly but signals the anagram of SISTER A NOD.
explanation.definitionFit: Skill and dexterity amount to craft, and the exclamation 'such craft' marks the noun.

clue.text: Dispute over insect repellent

indicators.note: in a down clue over places the first word above the insect

parts.note: to resist is to oppose or dispute
an ant is an insect

explanation.surface: An argument over which insect spray to use.
explanation.walkthrough: 'repellent' looks like a noun such as insect spray but is the adjective: withstanding.
explanation.definitionFit: Something water-repellent is resistant to it: able to keep it out.

clue.text: Hold the fort

definitions.meaning: the central tower of a castle, its stronghold

explanation.surface: An order to maintain the defence while others are away.
explanation.definitionFit: Retaining something is holding it; also the strongest inner tower of a castle.

clue.text: Cleaner grabs joint, being a pilferer

indicators.note: grabs means the word for cleaner holds the joint inside it

parts.note: purer means cleaner
a loin is a joint of meat

explanation.surface: A cleaner snatches a cut of meat, being a petty thief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cleaner' looks like a person who cleans; it is the comparative adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who steals small things, a thief, is one who purloins.

clue.text: The novice always needs a long time to arrange purchase

parts.note: L, the learner plate, stands for a novice
ever means always
an age is a long time

explanation.surface: A beginner always takes ages to arrange a purchase.
explanation.walkthrough: 'purchase' is the noun meaning mechanical grip, not buying.
explanation.definitionFit: A firm grip giving mechanical advantage, as with a lever, is purchase.

clue.text: Bearing with egghead, a good man

parts.note: the head of egg is its first letter, E
ST, for saint, is a good man

explanation.surface: Behaviour of an intellectual, a virtuous fellow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bearing' looks like demeanour but is a compass direction.
explanation.definitionFit: A compass direction such as this point is a bearing.

clue.text: Being superior about one's medico

indicators.note: about means the word for superior encloses the next piece

parts.note: better means superior
ones, as the possessive one's, gives ONES

explanation.surface: Feeling superior about one's doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: A medico is an informal word for a doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who sets broken bones practises a branch of medicine, an informal medic.

clue.text: Fastening device saving weight

parts.note: saving means except, as does but
a ton is a weight

explanation.surface: A clasp that cuts weight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'saving' is the old preposition meaning except.
explanation.definitionFit: A small disc pushed through a hole to fasten clothing.

clue.text: Concerned with spring initiative

parts.note: re means about, concerned with
a spring is a source of water

explanation.surface: Taking the lead in matters of seasonal planning.
explanation.definitionFit: Ingenuity and inventiveness in meeting difficulties is resource or initiative.

clue.text: Dress the same — that's invariable

parts.note: to rig out is to dress
ID is short for idem, Latin for the same

explanation.surface: A uniform rule: always dress identically.
explanation.definitionFit: Unbending and fixed, so unchanging and invariable.

clue.text: A little white, red, or yellow mollusc

indicators.note: A little says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A small shellfish described in a list of colours.
explanation.walkthrough: The colour list is camouflage: the run starts in 'white' and ends in 'or'.
explanation.definitionFit: The shipworm is a boring bivalve, a kind of mollusc.

clue.text: Live in East Street — number 11

indicators.note: in places the number inside the letters for East and Street

parts.note: E is the compass abbreviation for East
XI is eleven in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Living at number eleven, East Street.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: to be alive and have being, as creatures do, is to live.

clue.text: A stud manager

definitions.meaning: a raised ornamental knob or stud, as on a shield
the person in charge at work

explanation.surface: A man running a horse-breeding farm.
explanation.definitionFit: A raised knob on a shield is a stud, and the person in charge at work is the manager.

clue.text: Make allowances?

parts.note: sounds like being tolerant, but means to give out allowances of money

explanation.surface: A plea to be lenient with someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To give money for a purpose, such as a student's maintenance, is to award it.

clue.text: Love a fellow — admit the relationship

indicators.note: admit means the a-and-fellow pair lets the relationship in

parts.note: a don is a fellow of a college
a ratio is a relationship between quantities

explanation.surface: Romantic love between two men, now openly acknowledged.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep devotion or worship is a form of love.

clue.text: Sets off, though there may be no date set

indicators.note: may be suggests the letters could be arranged otherwise

explanation.surface: Explosions are triggered though nobody has fixed a date.
explanation.definitionFit: To explode a charge is to set it off.

clue.text: Finding note enclosed in listening equipment, he'll scoff

indicators.note: enclosed in places the note within the listening organ

parts.note: the ear is the organ for listening
TE is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Discovering a message hidden in a bugging device, he mocks.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who scoffs food is one who eats.
